parsed.name: A2D继电器板
parsed.description: 一款用于实验室自动化的继电器切换板，可控制电源与电子负载的连接状态，并支持多通道切换、板载指示灯控制以及I2C扩展器地址设置。常用于自动测试工装中的电源路径切换与设备联接控制。
parsed.description_en: A relay switching board for laboratory automation that controls the connection state of power supplies and electronic loads. It supports multi-channel switching, onboard LED control, and I2C expander address configuration, and is commonly used for power-path switching and equipment connection control in automated test setups.
